“The rule requiring four generations of nobility or else the candidate is not eligible.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0058", "tag": "p", "text": "“A man not eligible for a lieutenancy in the army unless he can prove four generations of noble descent?”", "sha256": "cc4b81653bc8fb276d29ea34589dab0f0aec9b27c05471b92fb934c198bd9ff0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[58]", "source_html": "

“A man not eligible for a lieutenancy in the army unless he can prove four generations of noble descent?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0059", "tag": "p", "text": "“Even so; neither lieutenant nor any other officer may be commissioned without that qualification.”", "sha256": "335d1de55830bf0b6e0bee8ec103ddce4e59d0d05bd65e6f4ca827f2610b29d9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[59]", "source_html": "

“Even so; neither lieutenant nor any other officer may be commissioned without that qualification.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0060", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, come, this is an astonishing thing. What good is such a qualification as that?”", "sha256": "565bf4b1fb7b98e3835f86db2def65e3b6069117353a70d4ea84891e3f040166", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[60]", "source_html": "

“Oh, come, this is an astonishing thing. What good is such a qualification as that?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0061", "tag": "p", "text": "“What good? It is a hardy question, fair sir and Boss, since it doth go far to impugn the wisdom of even our holy Mother Church herself.”", "sha256": "156808baa85cfd38224bb959e7af95799de17da9784f6ef91fe81e76c855da8a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[61]", "source_html": "

“What good? It is a hardy question, fair sir and Boss, since it doth go far to impugn the wisdom of even our holy Mother Church herself.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0062", "tag": "p", "text": "“As how?”", "sha256": "c7f22207bc7b24648f6f18e49d43b1b0434fe37829294b36b5a7b16e5101e6c3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[62]", "source_html": "

“As how?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0063", "tag": "p", "text": "“For that she hath established the self-same rule regarding saints. By her law none may be canonized until he hath lain dead four generations.”", "sha256": "612f158c70ab84e45c4124034bbe86a409e90242cb54b52a3b5dabe7c57400c9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[63]", "source_html": "

“For that she hath established the self-same rule regarding saints. By her law none may be canonized until he hath lain dead four generations.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0064", "tag": "p", "text": "“I see, I see—it is the same thing. It is wonderful. In the one case a man lies dead-alive four generations—mummified in ignorance and sloth—and that qualifies him to command live people, and take their weal and woe into his impotent hands; and in the other case, a man lies bedded with death and worms four generations, and that qualifies him for office in the celestial camp. Does the king’s grace approve of this strange law?”", "sha256": "83d64340730170157bf7400db2a9c3fe082f527b4acf6878dfc06fe61a854dac", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[64]", "source_html": "

“I see, I see—it is the same thing. It is wonderful. In the one case a man lies dead-alive four generations—mummified in ignorance and sloth—and that qualifies him to command live people, and take their weal and woe into his impotent hands; and in the other case, a man lies bedded with death and worms four generations, and that qualifies him for office in the celestial camp. Does the king’s grace approve of this strange law?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0065", "tag": "p", "text": "The king said:", "sha256": "ef026c17297c93d1af1001346b94ace93e8ddf08e8364013d7947f47c7042ddb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[65]", "source_html": "

The king said:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0066", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, truly I see naught about it that is strange. All places of honor and of profit do belong, by natural right, to them that be of noble blood, and so these dignities in the army are their property and would be so without this or any rule. The rule is but to mark a limit. Its purpose is to keep out too recent blood, which would bring into contempt these offices, and men of lofty lineage would turn their backs and scorn to take them. I were to blame an I permitted this calamity. [[I]]You[[/I]] can permit it an you are minded so to do, for you have the delegated authority, but that the king should do it were a most strange madness and not comprehensible to any.”", "sha256": "8fecb70183ab966486d167b5280b853a5049c39ee678f012d09277c541fabe81", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[66]", "source_html": "

“Why, truly I see naught about it that is strange. All places of honor and of profit do belong, by natural right, to them that be of noble blood, and so these dignities in the army are their property and would be so without this or any rule. The rule is but to mark a limit. Its purpose is to keep out too recent blood, which would bring into contempt these offices, and men of lofty lineage would turn their backs and scorn to take them. I were to blame an I permitted this calamity. You can permit it an you are minded so to do, for you have the delegated authority, but that the king should do it were a most strange madness and not comprehensible to any.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0069", "tag": "p", "text": "“By what illustrious achievement for the honor of the Throne and State did the founder of your great line lift himself to the sacred dignity of the British nobility?”", "sha256": "662e86f045cdc2e834823db2dffd5ff1d48a8acea1fbe9f4f4d41bd63f6598d6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[69]", "source_html": "
